name: Partner discount on derived maintenance (non-renewal, applied once)
what_it_tests: A partner-deal derived maintenance non-renewal line gets a SEPARATE partner-discount path that applies the discount once and avoids the standard double-discount
proc_mechanism: Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance (ItemIsDerived=true AND Deal_Type__c NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction' AND QuoteTypeText NotEquals 'Renewal'); Stamp Partner Unit Price - Derived Maintenance; PartnerNetPricePosthook
expected_behavior: Partner discount applied once to derived net; no double discount
test_setup: Derived maintenance line, Deal_Type='Partner Originated', New quote (not renewal), not LastTransaction

run3_result.defectStep: PartnerNetPricePosthook.resolveContributorCarryForwardByMaintenanceQuoteLines / buildContributorCarryForwardSnapshot / resolveContributorPartnerPercent (line ~1514): returns contributorLine.PartnerDiscountPercent (license Software band = 15) and propagates it via ContributorCarryForwardSnapshot.partnerPercent; loadNewMaintenanceLines (line ~1372) then sets partnerPercent = contributor.partnerPercent for the New Maintenance line. The general partner path that DOES resolve the correct band (getMarginForProductType, line ~569) is explicitly bypassed for derived maintenance by isDerivedMaintenanceProductType (line 550-552 returns null for 'New Maintenance'/'Renewal Maintenance'). So the derived-maint branch never calls getMarginForProductType(model,'New Maintenance')=12 and instead carries the contributor's 15%.
run3_result.proposedFix: In the derived-maintenance partner path (loadNewMaintenanceLines / computeNewBusinessMaintenanceNets), resolve the partner percent from the Quote's Partner_Pricing_Model__c via PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, 'New Maintenance') instead of inheriting ContributorCarryForwardSnapshot.partnerPercent from the contributor line.
